svg.title: Who decides what an evening clinic should achieve?
svg.desc: Clinical evidence : Assess expected effects, possible harms and uncertainty. Public priorities : Decide who faces barriers and how to fund easier access. Accountability : Publish reasons and explain what evidence could change the decision.

g.text: Who decides what an evening clinic should achieve?
Assess expected effects, possible harms and uncertainty.
Decide who faces barriers and how to fund easier access.
Publish reasons and explain what evidence could change the decision.
